mapper.sql: o.order_id, o.order_reference, o.merchant_reference, o.account_id, o.shopper_id, shopper_country.iso_code AS shopper_country, shopper_subdivision.code AS shopper_country_subdivision, currency.currency_code AS currency, o.net_amount, o.tax_amount, o.gross_amount, o.idempotency_key, o.request_fingerprint, o.payment_reference, o.psp_account_id, o.psp_reference, o.payment_link, o.created_ts

JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = o.currency_id JOIN country shopper_country ON shopper_country.country_id = o.shopper_country_id LEFT JOIN country_subdivision shopper_subdivision ON shopper_subdivision.country_subdivision_id = o.shopper_country_subdivision_id
item.order_item_id, item.order_id, product_type.code AS product_type, item.order_line_reference, item.merchant_line_reference, item.net_amount, item.tax_amount, item.tax_rate
shopper.shopper_id, shopper.email, shopper.full_name, country.iso_code AS country, subdivision.code AS country_subdivision, shopper.postal_code
JOIN country ON country.country_id = shopper.country_id LEFT JOIN country_subdivision subdivision ON subdivision.country_subdivision_id = shopper.country_subdivision_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM order_item item JOIN product_type ON product_type.product_type_id = item.product_type_id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY item.order_item_id
SELECT psp.code AS psp_code, o.psp_reference FROM merchant_order o JOIN account psp ON psp.account_id = o.psp_account_id WHERE o.payment_reference = #{paymentReference}

WITH shopper AS ( INSERT INTO shopper_detail (email, full_name, country_id, country_subdivision_id, postal_code) VALUES ( #{email}, #{fullName}, (SELECT country_id FROM country WHERE iso_code = #{country}), (SELECT subdivision.country_subdivision_id FROM country_subdivision subdivision JOIN country ON country.country_id = subdivision.country_id WHERE country.iso_code = #{country} AND subdivision.code = #{countrySubdivision,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{postalCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM shopper

WITH o AS ( INSERT INTO merchant_order ( order_reference, merchant_reference, account_id, account_type_id, shopper_id, shopper_country_id, shopper_country_subdivision_id, currency_id, net_amount, tax_amount, gross_amount, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, payment_reference, psp_account_id, created_ts ) VALUES ( #{orderReference}, #{merchantReference}, #{accountId}, (SELECT account_type_id FROM account_type WHERE code = 'MERCHANT'), #{shopperId}, (SELECT country_id FROM country WHERE iso_code = #{shopperCountry}), (SELECT subdivision.country_subdivision_id FROM country_subdivision subdivision JOIN country ON country.country_id = subdivision.country_id WHERE country.iso_code = #{shopperCountry} AND subdivision.code = #{shopperCountrySubdivision,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), (SELECT currency_id FROM currency WHERE currency_code = #{currency}), #{netAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{grossAmount}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{paymentReference}, #{pspAccountId}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (account_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM o

WITH item AS ( INSERT INTO order_item ( order_id, product_type_id, order_line_reference, merchant_line_reference, net_amount, tax_amount, tax_rate ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, (SELECT product_type_id FROM product_type WHERE code = #{productType}), #{orderLineReference}, #{merchantLineReference}, #{netAmount}, #{taxAmount}, #{taxRate} ) RETURNING * ) SELECT FROM item JOIN product_type ON product_type.product_type_id = item.product_type_id
